newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF MEN'S 800 METRES WORLD CHAMPION KIPKETER.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF MEN'S 800 METRES WORLD CHAMPION KIPKETER.

text.p: Profile of Wilson Kipketer, who won the world men's 800 metres title on Friday.
Has been ranked world number one over 800 metres in 1994, 1995 and 1996 and won the world title two years ago in Gothenburg.

Has lived in Denmark since Nov 1990. In May 1995, became eligible to compete for Denmark. Was not allowed to compete at last year's Olympics following a protest over his nationality from the Kenyan Athletics Federation.
Broke the world record twice at the world indoor championships last March in Paris. Equalled Seb Coe's 16-year-old outdoor mark of one minute 41.73 seconds last month in Stockholm.
